   "source": [
    "### Set constants"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "dc26c343",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "- `mouse_option` : When `data_option = “fujiwara”`, `“mESC#1”` and `“mESC#2”` disappear (`‘drop’`). Only `“drop”` exists.\n",
    "\n",
    "- `gene_option` : Whether to restrict the analysis to only genes common to all species (`“intersection”`) or not (`“distinct”`)\n",
    "\n",
    "- `threshold_option` : Whether the threshold for masking in the “preprocessing” process should be automatically adjusted (`\"auto\"`) or fixed to the value of `threshold_surer` (`\"manual\"`)\n",
    "\n",
    "- `metric_option` : Whether the distance matrix between genes is calculated using Euclidean distance (`\"euclidean\"`) or after weighting the genes (`\"weighted\"`)\n",
    "\n",
    "- `dismat_option` : Whether to use principal component analyzed data (`\"pca\"`) or original data (`\"original\"`)\n",
    "\n",
    "- `gwot_option` : Whether to use the smallest hyperparameter epsilon (`\"min\"`) or only the initial value (`\"fixed\"`) when performing gromov-wasserstein ot calculations"
   ]
  },
  {
